mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (rank_id, email, password, nickname, point, provider) VALUES (#{rankId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{point}, #{provider})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE nickname = #{nickname} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT user_id, rank_id, email, password, nickname, point, provider FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET point = LEAST(10000, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(point, 0) + #{point})) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT point FROM member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT nickname FROM member where user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
